verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), framed for 'developers and their agents'. The docs also include agent-directed setup content that works with Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, so an agent can be pointed at it. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md variant returned 404), evidence of llms.txt depth or completeness (such as llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Sentry is an application monitoring platform that helps developers and their agents have the context needed
Your agent will set up Sentry in your Python app automatically. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and more.
